scripts.mapctl: pnpm -s version:sync && swift package clean && swift run mapctl
scripts.lint: swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests && DYLD_FRAMEWORK_PATH="$(xcode-select -p)/usr/lib" swiftlint --strict && shellcheck -x scripts/*.sh
scripts.check: pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s test && pnpm -s coverage
scripts.build: pnpm -s version:sync && mkdir -p bin && swift build -c release --product mapctl && cp .build/release/mapctl bin/mapctl && codesign --force --sign - --identifier com.jdharmon.mapctl bin/mapctl
